datasetDef: OpenNeuro ds000030 (UCLA CNP, CC0): fmriprep surface-sampled resting-state BOLD (fsaverage5) from the published derivatives — 250 usable subjects (118 CN, 45 SCZ, 48 BD, 39 ADHD); excluded: 0 missing/incomplete, 11 high motion (mean FD > 0.5 mm; by group {'CONTROL': 4, 'SCHZ': 5, 'BIPOLAR': 1, 'ADHD': 1}), 0 short scans. Motion-exclusion rates differ by group — residual motion confounding cannot be ruled out. Representation sanity check, NOT diagnosis.
preprocessing: One vector per subject: DK-68 parcel mean timeseries (fsaverage aparc annot restricted to fsaverage5 vertices); confound regression (6 motion params + WhiteMatter + aCompCor00 + linear trend); Pearson correlation -> Fisher z -> upper triangle (2278 features).
model: Fold-safe Pipeline(StandardScaler -> PCA-50 -> L2 logistic), stratified 10-fold CV over subjects, pooled out-of-fold ROC-AUC; 1000 label permutations refitting the full CV (p = (1+#perm>=obs)/(1+N)); subject-bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples).
